name: cap-dashboard-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions (2nd gen, hosting/runtime only) for CAP Dashboard. Data and auth are fully on Supabase (cutover 2026-08-13) -- these functions exist only because Postgres RLS alone can't enforce 'creator or admin' authorization (see functions/lib/dashboardNotes.js); no Firebase Admin SDK, Firestore, or Firebase Auth usage remains.
